title: The Six Tape Drive
why_movie: A real first-person Kevin habit story with a place (his apartment, his car) and a turn: he measured his whole life in cassette tapes, and successful people measured a drive not in miles but in how many tapes it took.
keep: So at 5 a.m., it goes full blast
right when I'm coming out of deep sleep, when I'm in alpha
when I get into the car, I'd take the cassette player
when I'm driving to work, I'm listening to the tape
Oh yeah, I'm going to this restaurant
That was a six tape drive

scenes.on: So at 5 a.m., it goes full blast
scenes.gen: A worn wooden nightstand in a small 1970s apartment bedroom at dawn, a chunky analog cassette tape player wired to a plug-in wall timer, grey pre-dawn light at the window
scenes.move: the timer's dial clicks over and the cassette player's play button pops down as it switches on

scenes.on: right when I'm coming out of deep sleep
scenes.gen: Close view of a young man's head on a pillow in a dim 1970s bedroom, eyes still closed, early morning light creeping through curtains, a small cassette player glowing on the nightstand beside him
scenes.move: his eyes slowly begin to open as he stirs toward waking

scenes.on: when I get into the car, I'd take the cassette player
scenes.gen: A man in 1970s clothing getting into the driver's seat of an old sedan in an apartment parking lot at sunrise, carrying a bulky portable cassette player in one hand
scenes.move: he sets the cassette player down on the passenger seat beside him and starts the engine

scenes.on: when I'm driving to work, I'm listening to the tape
scenes.gen: Inside an old car driving down a suburban street at sunrise, a portable cassette player sitting on the passenger seat with its reels turning, the driver's hands on the wheel
scenes.move: the cassette player's spools turn steadily as the car moves past storefronts

scenes.on: Oh yeah, I'm going to this restaurant
scenes.gen: The same old car driving past a glowing neon restaurant sign at night on a city street, warm lights reflecting on the wet road
scenes.move: the car slows and its headlights sweep across the restaurant's neon sign

scenes.on: That was a six tape drive
scenes.gen: A close view from the passenger seat of six cassette tapes lined up neatly in a row on the car seat, a highway stretching ahead through the windshield at dusk
scenes.move: a hand reaches over and flips the last cassette tape over

payoff: That was a six tape drive
caption:
Comment "WISH" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's 14 Your Wish Is Your Command audios. Free.

Kevin Trudeau says that before anyone had cassette decks built into a car, he built his whole day around one: a timer plugged into the wall clicked his tape player on at 5 a.m., right as he was waking up, so a motivational speech was the first thing he ever heard.

Then he carried that same tape player everywhere - into the shower, onto the car seat, through a full day of work, and all the way home.

Successful people he knew didn't measure a drive in miles. They measured it in tapes.

{episode}

The 14 audios are Kevin teaching the mind techniques that actually move you forward. Recorded live at a private event in the Alps.

Comment "WISH" if you want them.
